name: termhub
description: Web terminal over Tailscale — open and reattach to shell sessions on a machine from your browser, including Claude Code. One standalone server per machine.

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/lib/xterm.js web/vendor/xterm.js && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css web/vendor/xterm.css && cp node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.js web/vendor/addon-fit.js && cp node_modules/@xterm/addon-webgl/lib/addon-webgl.js web/vendor/addon-webgl.js
scripts.test: node test/voiceCommands.test.js && node test/restore.test.js && node test/claudeCli.test.js && node test/state.test.js

claudeCli._comment: The Claude Code CLI termhub's --session-id/--resume handling and transcript reading are verified against (lib/claudeCli.js). Bump both when a newer CLI has been exercised: launch a claude session, restore it after a sessiond restart, and confirm the model badge and spoken announcements still resolve.
